cookies.title: LinkedIn cookies
cookies.description: Cookie-Editor JSON export (array), or a cookie header string that includes li_at (and ideally JSESSIONID).

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Optional. Match the browser that created the cookie session.

profiles.title: Profiles to connect
profiles.description: LinkedIn profile URLs. Optional per-profile connection note (Premium; ~300 chars).

delaySeconds.title: Delay between profiles (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Base delay; actual wait is random between delay and 2× delay.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Open profiles and find Connect, but do not click Send.
